profile.headline: Full Stack Senior Software Engineer | CDN & Akamai | Quantum Metric | AI Observability & Monitoring | Caching | WAF | Bot Manager | API Protection | PMP® |
profile.summary:
Technology professional with 10+ years of experience across software engineering, digital experience, web technologies, full stack engineering, analytics, observability, and enterprise platforms.

In my current role at Western Union, I work across CDN and edge technologies, digital observability, and customer experience. My work includes Akamai CDN, Quantum Metric, Amplitude, Dynatrace, and Splunk—helping improve application performance, monitor customer journeys, analyze session replays, identify customer frustration and friction points, troubleshoot production issues, and turn behavioral and operational data into actionable insights.

I hold a Master of Science in Information Technology and Management (MS ITM) from The University of Texas at Dallas and am a certified Project Management Professional (PMP).

I’m particularly interested in the next generation of AI-powered software and am actively expanding my expertise in Agentic AI, AI Engineering, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG, Prompt Engineering, AI Agents, MCP, LangChain/LangGraph, and Generative AI.

My goal is to combine my background in software engineering, observability, analytics, and customer experience with AI to build intelligent systems that can understand, reason, automate, and solve real-world business problems.

positions.title: Senior Project Engineer
positions.description:
● Served as the POC for Akamai vendor coordination, technical discussions, issue, and project activities.

● Managed project backlogs, epics, user stories, sprint tasks, defects, and delivery milestones using Jira.

● Maintained documentation, requirements, technical specifications, and implementation plans in Confluence.

● Coordinated ServiceNow change requests, approvals, deployments, risk assessments, and rollback activities.

● Supported SDLC, including requirements gathering, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.

● Mentored team members on observability and data-driven practices from session-based analytics.

● Identified project risks, technical blockers, operational dependencies, and implementation challenges.
● Supported enterprise technology implementations, application migrations, CDN modernization initiatives.
● Coordinated sprint planning, resource allocation discussions, task assignments, and capacity planning.

● Supported AI initiatives focused on intelligent automation, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics.

positions.description:
● Prepared comprehensive software requirement specifications and risk assessments for cloud applications.
● Efficiently managed project plans and resources for an intranet application, optimizing operational efficiency.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (PMP)
positions.description:
Owned enterprise digital experience monitoring and session analytics, enabling real-time visibility into customer behavior, friction points, and conversion bottlenecks across high-traffic customer-facing applications.

Led cross-functional adoption and governance of digital experience analytics platforms, defining event standards, access controls, and operating models used by Product, UX, Engineering, and Business teams.

Partnered with Product Management to translate customer experience insights into roadmap priorities, directly influencing feature improvements and measurable gains in funnel performance and user satisfaction.

Drove product analytics strategy, designing event taxonomies, funnels, and cohort analyses to measure activation, engagement, and retention across multiple product surfaces.


Provided technical leadership for global content delivery and edge performance optimization, improving page load times, availability, resilience, and security for customer-facing platforms.

Configured and managed Akamai Property Manager for caching, origin routing, SSL/TLS, and edge behaviors.

Implemented Cloudlets (Redirect & Rewrite) for URL redirection, geo-routing, A/B testing, and edge-based request manipulation.

Designed and enforced WAF (Web Application Firewall) rules to mitigate OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities including SQL injection, XSS, and command injection.

Configured and maintained API Protection policies to secure REST endpoints using rate limiting, schema validation, and threat detection.

Implemented Account Protector to prevent credential stuffing and account takeover attacks.

Managed Bot Manager to detect and mitigate malicious bots while allowing legitimate traffic.

Integrated DataStream logs with Grafana and Dynatrace for real-time monitoring, alerting, and performance analysis.

Utilized Security Analytics and Edge Diagnostics/EdgeWorkers (if applicable) for threat visibility and troubleshooting edge behavior.
